source_signature.text:
theorem exists_pureState_extension (D : StarSubalgebra ℂ A) [IsClosed (D : Set A)]
    (chi : WeakDual.characterSpace ℂ D) :
    ∃ phi : A →L[ℂ] ℂ,
      phi ∈ stateSpace A ∧ IsPureState A phi ∧ ∀ d : D, phi d = chi d
